content:
Right after catching AirPods Pro 3 dropping to one of their lowest prices ever, the fall Prime Day deals are already rolling in, covering the latest Mac lineup. The all-new M6 Mac mini series has hit its all-time low prices with savings of up to nearly $150, while the 2026 Mac Studio is seeing close to $200 off.

These deals are in addition to a steady $200 discount on nearly all M5 MacBook Air models, ongoing $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the first discount on Apple's newly released minimalist full-character Magic Keyboard, and a rare price cut on the Magic Mouse.

If you're considering a MacBook, the fall Prime Day has brought the Apple M5 MacBook Air lineup to its lowest prices in recent months. Amazon is now offering a steady $200 off across nearly every configuration, with most models available in multiple colours:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB — $1,099 (was $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB — $1,399 (was $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB — $1,599 (was $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB — $1,299 (was $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB — $1,599 (was $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB — $1,799 (was $1,999)

Amazon brought some seriously impressive discounts to Apple's all-new Mac mini lineup this morning. From the entry-level M6 configuration to the high-end M5 Max model, we're now seeing up to $149 off — the lowest prices ever recorded:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB — $780 (was $899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB — $950 (was $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB — $1,550 (was $1,699) — all-time low

These deals also include the all-time low price on the all-new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM, with Amazon now knocking $199 off the MSRP — the best offer we've seen since its launch last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio — $2,300 (was $2,499) — all-time low

While we're still waiting for (and even hoping for) more MacBook Pro deals, Amazon is still offering a hefty $500 off this upgraded 2TB model — a discount that brings the price $100 below its pre-increase MSRP:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB — $2,699 (was $3,199)

Beyond all that, we've also tracked some solid discounts on Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, the Magic Mouse in both black and white is now seeing rare price cuts of up to nearly 25% off MSRP, along with the first discount on Apple's just-released all-new Magic Keyboard featuring a stunning full-character design:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (all-new 2026 model) — $80 (was $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse in white — $60 (was $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse in black — $80 (was $99)
